data.label: Alert Acknowledger
data.description: Clicks 'dismiss' professionally. Has achieved inbox zero by ignoring everything.

data.label: False Positive Hunter
data.description: Tuned the SIEM once. Made it worse. Now everything is a false positive.

data.label: Compliance Checkbox Specialist
data.description: 'We're SOC2 compliant.' (They are not.)

data.label: Threat Feed Collector
data.description: Subscribed to 40 feeds. Reads none. Dashboards look impressive though.

data.label: Incident Postmortem Author
data.description: Writes detailed postmortems. Learns nothing. Same incident next quarter.

data.label: Pentest PDF Archiver
data.description: Has 200 penetration test reports. Zero remediations. 'We'll get to it.'

data.label: Unused IDS Monitor
data.description: The IDS has been in 'learning mode' for three years.

data.label: EDR Whisperer
data.description: The one person who actually knows what the agent does. Feared. Respected.

data.label: Firewall Rule Archaeologist
data.description: Excavates ancient rules. 'Allow any any' from 2009. Nobody knows why.

data.label: Password Policy Enforcer
data.description: Requires 47 character passwords. Changed monthly. Wonders why everyone uses sticky notes.

data.label: VPN Troubleshooter
data.description: 'Have you tried disconnecting and reconnecting?' Has said this 10,000 times.

data.label: Certificate Expiry Ignorer
data.description: The alerts have been firing for months. 'It's on the backlog.'

data.label: YAML Farmer
data.description: Tends vast fields of indentation. One space off and the harvest fails.

data.label: Jenkins Shaman
data.description: The pipeline is 9000 lines. Nobody dares touch it. It works. Sometimes.

data.label: Kubernetes Theorist
data.description: Has never run kubectl. Has opinions about service meshes. Strong opinions.

data.label: VM Sprawl Curator
data.description: 900 VMs. 12 are used. The rest are 'probably important.'

data.label: Technical Debt Ranger
data.description: Assigned to 'quick fix' from 2019. Still ranging.

data.label: BGP Berserker
data.description: Once null-routed a continent. Would do it again.

data.label: Cable Archaeologist
data.description: Traces cables through the ceiling void. Finds things. Terrible things.

data.label: DNS Wizard
data.description: It's always DNS. Always. They know this. They've accepted it.

data.label: Raised Floor Spelunker
data.description: Descends beneath the datacenter tiles with a headlamp and returns with cables nobody remembers installing.

data.label: HVAC Whisperer
data.description: Communes with the cooling units. Knows which CRAC unit is lying about its setpoint.

data.label: Rack Tetris Champion
data.description: Fits 43U of equipment into a 42U rack. Nobody asks how.

data.label: Packet Autopsy Surgeon
data.description: Opens pcaps the way others open cold cases. The packet always tells the truth eventually.

data.label: NAT Traversal Mystic
data.description: Sees through double NAT. Speaks fluent STUN. Refuses to explain hairpinning at parties.

data.label: Captive Portal Escapologist
data.description: Has never once clicked 'I agree to the terms'. The hotel wifi fears them.

data.label: Cron Job Necromancer
data.description: Raises long-dead scheduled jobs and occasionally puts them back down. Knows what runs at 3:07 AM and why.

data.label: Container Escape Artist
data.description: Gets out of any pod, sandbox, or namespace. Strictly for legitimate debugging purposes.

data.label: Golden Image Curator
data.description: Maintains the one true base image. All other images are derivative works and they will say so.

data.label: Quota Negotiator
data.description: Argues with resource limits for a living. Has never met a namespace it couldn't expand.

data.label: Regex Exorcist
data.description: Called in when the pattern matches things it should not. Reads catastrophic backtracking like scripture.

data.label: Legacy Code Docent
data.description: Gives guided tours of code nobody else will enter. Knows which functions are load-bearing.

data.label: Feature Flag Janitor
data.description: Sweeps up flags that shipped in 2019 and were never removed. The if-statements remember.

data.label: Stack Trace Sommelier
data.description: Swirls the exception, notes hints of null pointer with an off-by-one finish. Vintage: production.

data.label: Schema Drift Tracker
data.description: Follows the migration trail. Can tell you the exact quarter the column stopped meaning what its name says.

data.label: Backup Restore Doubter
data.description: A backup is a rumor until it has been restored. Trusts nothing. Verifies everything. Annually disappointed.

data.label: Data Lake Lifeguard
data.description: Watches the lake become a swamp in real time. Occasionally rescues a drowning dataset.
